models.title: Daylight reach
models.equation: min(room depth, window head height × 1.5 × (visible transmittance / 0.70))
models.limits: 12 × 12 plan samples. The transmittance factor is an implementation heuristic. No lux, glare, sDA or annual daylight validation.
models.transfer: Requires actual window geometry, workplanes and obstructions before office evaluation.

models.title: Connected airflow
models.equation: Q = Cd × Aeq × wind speed × √|ΔCp|; Aeq = 1 / √Σ(1/Ai²)
models.limits: Uses fixed aperture areas and representative pressure coefficients. Interior open-door paths connect exterior pressure faces. No CFD or high-rise pressure validation.
models.transfer: Reuse connectivity and explicit assumptions; replace wind pressure, opening areas and stack effects for a tower.

models.title: Envelope heat
models.equation: Conduction = U × area × temperature difference; solar gain = irradiance × glass area × SHGC × incidence
models.limits: Walls, doors and windows only. Excludes roof, floor, infiltration, bridges, internal loads and hourly weather.
models.transfer: Requires per-face glazing fractions, assembly inputs and orientation before energy comparison.

models.title: Route connectivity
models.equation: Continuous room → door → room graph ending at an exterior door
models.limits: Centerline route approximation. Does not establish legal travel distance, widths, stairs, fire compartments or occupant load.
models.transfer: Extend the graph across floors and protected stairs before any high-rise egress evaluation.

provenanceFindings.note: Stored minimum door width is 0.81 m; its source comment describes 815 mm. Preserve the stored value for provenance; verify and resolve before enforcement.
Stored turning diameter is 1.5 m while its comment also says 60 in. Exact inch conversion is 1.524 m. This pack does not adjudicate the applicable standard.
A single residential ceiling value does not encode all room types, exceptions or office applicability.
src/analysis/ventilation.ts contains an opening-count score; the audited Value Lens uses windFlow.ts with a pressure-connected graph. Do not promote the older score as airflow performance.
No commercial office rent standard, high-rise core-sizing rule, office occupant-load pack or rentable-area measurement standard was found in the reviewed standards library.
